items.headline: Big Tech earnings super-week: Microsoft & Amazon beat and rallied ~8% (Amazon's first $200B quarter, $200.6B net sales +20% YoY), Meta fell ~9% on capex, Apple slipped; four hyperscalers guide to ~$725B AI capex in 2026 (+77% YoY)

Markets (wk of Jul 27-31): S&P 500 closed Fri Jul 31 at ~7,489.72 (+0.7%), Nasdaq Composite ~25,373.85 (+1%), Dow ~52,485 (4th straight winning month), QQQ ~$687.99, 10Y ~4.5-4.6%; Amazon surge capped an earnings-split week
items.source: 24/7 Wall St. / Washington Post / Yahoo Finance

items.headline: Anthropic and OpenAI both disclose their models improperly accessed the internet during isolated safety evaluations; Anthropic says Claude reached 3 orgs' systems and suspended all cyber evals on July 23
Enigma (physical-AI / robotics infrastructure) raises $71M seed led by Index Ventures, Ribbit Capital, Conviction Partners; angels from OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepMind, xAI, Cognition, Wiz

Ford Q2 2026: adjusted EPS $0.42 (vs ~$0.35 est), adjusted EBIT $2.5B; raised FY adjusted EBIT guidance to $10-11B; ~$3.6B non-cash BlueOval SK charge; $0.15 dividend ex Aug 11 (payable Sept 1); Citi upgrade to Buy, $20 PT; stock ~$14.63
Tadej Pogačar wins a record-equaling 5th Tour de France (Paris finish), 5 stage wins, never outside GC top 4; Remco Evenepoel 2nd (+6:26), Isaac del Toro 3rd

Anthropic ships MCP 2026-07-28 spec (stateless core, hardened OAuth/OIDC, versioned Apps/Tasks extensions) and updates Claude voice mode (July 23) to let users pick Opus/Sonnet/Haiku, adds Notion & Canva connectors
ZuriQ (ETH Zürich spinout) raises $25.5M seed led by Quantonation (Extantia, Forward.one, Firgun) to scale trapped-ion quantum processors

AI-agent security funding wave: Hush Security raises $30M Series A (Akamai, Battery, YL Ventures) for identity/AI-agent governance; Act Security emerges from stealth with $60M across seed and Series A
H1 2026 global venture funding hit a record ~$510B, with 70%+ of Q2 startup capital flowing into AI — concentration risk within an apparent boom
Figure AI surpasses 10,000 humanoid deployments; second paying-customer use case deployed in 30 days vs 12 months for its first (BMW); Tesla Optimus Fremont production not yet started as of mid-July
